# package npdu

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-bacnet/npdu"
```

Package npdu implements BACnet Network Layer Protocol Data Units.

Strict BACnet/IP uses a framing decoder: reserved control bits, global broadcast with non-zero DADR, and odd-length router network lists are rejected as ErrMalformed.

npdu is a sibling wire codec: it may import github.com/otfabric/go-bacnet but must not import bvlc or apdu. APDU payload may alias the input buffer.

## Functions

### func Append

```go
func Append(dst []byte, n NPDU) ([]byte, error)
```

Append encodes an NPDU. For application messages, set APDU; for network messages set NetworkMessage, NetMsgType and NetMsgData.

The control octet is built from the typed fields: NetworkMessage, ExpectingReply (or the ControlExpectingReply bit of Control), Priority, and the Destination and Source addresses. Every other bit of Control — including the reserved bits and the DNET/SNET-present bits — is ignored, so a stale Control value cannot produce a frame that disagrees with its address fields.

A remote destination or source must name a real network: network numbers 0 and 0xFFFF are rejected, as is a remote station without a MAC address.

### func DecodeICouldBeRouterToNetwork

```go
func DecodeICouldBeRouterToNetwork(data []byte) (network uint16, perf uint8, err error)
```

DecodeICouldBeRouterToNetwork returns DNET and performance index.

### func DecodeNetworkList

```go
func DecodeNetworkList(data []byte) ([]uint16, error)
```

DecodeNetworkList decodes a sequence of 16-bit BACnet network numbers. Length must be even; network number 0 is rejected.

### func DecodeRejectMessageToNetwork

```go
func DecodeRejectMessageToNetwork(data []byte) (reason uint8, network uint16, err error)
```

DecodeRejectMessageToNetwork returns reason and DNET from Reject-Message-To-Network.

### type NPDU

```go
type NPDU struct {
	Version        uint8

	Destination    bacnet.Address

	HopCount       uint8
	NetworkMessage bool
	NetMsgType     uint8
	NetMsgData     []byte
	APDU           []byte
	ExpectingReply bool
	Priority       uint8
}
```

NPDU is a parsed network PDU. APDU aliases input when present.
